name: Holy Word
area: nongood creatures in a 40-ft.-radius spread centered on you
summary: Overwhelm nongood creatures according to how far their Hit Dice fall below your caster level.
description: Nongood creatures in the area suffer cumulative effects based on Hit Dice: creatures up to your caster level are deafened for 1d4 rounds; those up to caster level -1 are also blinded for 2d4 rounds; those up to caster level -5 are also paralyzed for 1d10 minutes; and those up to caster level -10 are killed. Nongood extraplanar creatures can also be banished to their home plane, with a Will save to negate that banishment.
